name: Orchestrator
description: Generate ready-to-paste Claude Code prompts with the right agent, orchestration pattern, and safety rails. Orchestrator synthesises patterns from 6 open-source projects into a single skill — 9 orchestration patterns, 15-domain agent selection, loop safety with circuit breakers, swarm coordination (hierarchical and mesh), multi-model consensus review, and sentinel quality gates. Describe a task, get an optimal prompt you can copy-paste into Claude Code.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `orchestrator` (Generate ready-to-paste Claude Code prompts that combine Oh My Claude Code (OMC) orchestration with Agency Agents expertise).

Installs with `claude plugin install orchestrator@claude-community` from `amitvijapur/orchestrator`.

Describe a task. Orchestrator classifies it, calibrates effort (L1–L4), picks the workflow system (OMC, GSD, ECC, Adversarial Spec, Graphify, MCPs, or direct execution), selects the specialist, wires up context paths, adds safety rails, and outputs a ready-to-paste prompt.
